title: Histology to MRI
description: Register 2D histology sections to an MRI volume: the section plane from an approximate slice, Greedy NMI rigid, affine and deformable registration in that plane, and an optional search of the plane's offset and tilt.

register.title: Register sections
register.description: Register one or more histology sections to the MRI near the given slice and return each section warped onto its plane, Greedy-compatible transforms and the sections drawn into the MRI grid.

sections.description: One or more 2D histology sections (RGB or greyscale TIFF, PNG or JPEG), in file-name order

axis.description: MRI voxel axis the sections are cut across (0 = i, 1 = j, 2 = k)

index.description: Approximate MRI slice index of the first section

tiltA.description: Starting tilt about the plane's first in-plane axis, in degrees

tiltB.description: Starting tilt about the plane's second in-plane axis, in degrees

contrast.description: Section contrast: brightness with the background made dark, or a colour-deconvolution stain channel

orientation.description: Section orientation: automatic, or k for a rotation of (k mod 4) × 90° after a flip when k ≥ 4

pixelSize.description: Section pixel size in micrometres; estimated from the tissue area when absent

refinePlane.description: Search the plane's offset and tilt for the best NMI

deformable.description: Finish with a deformable (stationary velocity) registration
